title: DeviceManifest
description: Signed attestation manifest emitted by a jitterbugs terminal box.

device_id.description: Globally unique device identifier assigned at manufacture.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of manifest creation. Must be within ±30 seconds of server time.

location.description: Best-available location fix at manifest creation time.

source.description: Technology used to obtain the fix.

hdop.description: GNSS Horizontal Dilution of Precision (present when source is GNSS or AssistedGNSS).

location_unavailable.description: Set to true when no location source meets the accuracy threshold. Mutually exclusive with 'location'.

coarse.description: True when latitude/longitude have been truncated to ~1 km resolution (coarse mode).

firmware_version.description: Semantic version string of device firmware.

device_key_id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the device's ed25519 public key, prefixed 'sha256:'.

tamper_flags.description: Bitmask of tamper sensor states. 0 = no tamper detected. See DEVICE_LOCATION.md for bit definitions.
